scripts.copy-data: mkdir -p public/data/phenomena public/data/stars public/data/sky_culture public/data/vsop87 public/data/elpmpp02 public/data/IAU2000 public/data/fit && (cp ../vendor/vsop87/VSOP87B.ear public/data/vsop87/ 2>/dev/null || true) && (cp ../vendor/vsop87/VSOP87B.ear.bin public/data/vsop87/ 2>/dev/null || true) && (cp ../vendor/vsop87/VSOP87B.ear.bin.br public/data/vsop87/ 2>/dev/null || true) && for f in ELP_MAIN.S1 ELP_MAIN.S2 ELP_MAIN.S3 ELP_PERT.S1 ELP_PERT.S2 ELP_PERT.S3; do cp ../vendor/elpmpp02/$f public/data/elpmpp02/ 2>/dev/null || true; cp ../vendor/elpmpp02/$f.bin public/data/elpmpp02/ 2>/dev/null || true; cp ../vendor/elpmpp02/$f.bin.br public/data/elpmpp02/ 2>/dev/null || true; done && (cp ../vendor/IAU2000/tab5.3a.txt public/data/IAU2000/ 2>/dev/null || true) && (cp ../vendor/IAU2000/tab5.3b.txt public/data/IAU2000/ 2>/dev/null || true) && (cp ../vendor/IAU2000/tab5.3a.bin public/data/IAU2000/ 2>/dev/null || true) && (cp ../vendor/IAU2000/tab5.3a.bin.br public/data/IAU2000/ 2>/dev/null || true) && for t in de406 de441; do cp ../data/fit/vsop87-$t-earth.bin public/data/fit/ 2>/dev/null || true; cp ../data/fit/vsop87-$t-earth.bin.br public/data/fit/ 2>/dev/null || true; done && cp ../data/phenomena/capitals.csv public/data/phenomena/ && for b in mer ven mar jup sat; do cp ../vendor/vsop87/VSOP87B.$b public/data/vsop87/; done && cp ../data/fit/vsop87-de406-planets.txt public/data/fit/ && cp ../data/stars/hipparcos_bright.csv public/data/stars/ && for f in chinese_asterisms chinese_star_names chinese_lunar_mansion_determinatives system_periods sanjia_schools; do cp ../data/sky_culture/$f.csv public/data/sky_culture/; done
